Data.title: Resident Population Aged 65 Years and Over in Resident Households by Level of Difficulty in Performing Basic Activity in Specific Domain, Living Arrangement and Sex
Data.footnote: Notes: For residents aged 65 years and over in resident households, the Living Arrangement categories are based on presence of their spouse and/or children (including children-in-law) in the same household. The classification also incorporates the labour force status of their children.Data on Living Arrangement of Residents Aged 65 and Over have been updated in June 2026 to incorporate refinements to the identification of child-in-law.
